drop_screens.why: 'top' is a crop of the top navigation bar (blur-under-header annotation); no phone, only a bar-wide box. The back / credit / new chat / history buttons are boxed on every chat screen.
'imput' is a crop of the input pill (annotation of the input bar), a duplicate of the pill drawn on every chat screen; its mic is the same as the others.

'ai' is a scroll-state annotation frame (an arrow from the bottom of one phone into a second, top-cropped phone) of the outline + Characters Result card already drawn on 2286:20903 / 2569:22653; its header buttons are unboxed duplicates of the ones elsewhere.

'content' is a text-content mock (Story Outline & Characters Result card without phone chrome) that repeats the card of 2286:19459 / 2286:20903; only the three character thumbnails are boxed and the card's refresh icons are the ones boxed on those screens.
